capabilities: SAP AI capability catalog from official SAP sources (developers.sap.com first), classified as AI-native, AI-enabling framework, AI integration tooling or discovery service
Evidence-level assessment of each capability on eight dimensions, never a score, computed only from approved published evidence
Hands-on evaluations: published findings read through identify, evaluate, align with hands-on, prove, compare and scope for improvement
Ask the Evidence: answers only from published findings, with catalog context labelled as documentation; unsupported questions are reported as not established
Versioned, hash-verified content releases with supersession, retraction and rollback
Optional supplementary lookup in SAP's public developer content, labelled as documentation
Optional synthetic practice exercises for learning the method
verified_public_tests: This file does not embed test results. Before release the build is checked against the source revision named in PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json: the public test suite (isolation, security and functional tests), a clean install on Windows and Linux, and a real-browser run. The qualification report for that revision is the evidence; it is held by the repository owner.
known_limitations: Public SAP endpoints are anonymous and best-effort; results can change or be unavailable.
No SAP system, trial, CAP, ADT or model is reachable from this edition.
Comparisons are qualitative and partly rest on observations from the project's own test runs in a private environment (assistant-run, not independently verified).
Session history is not stored; reload clears it.
changes: SAP AI capability evaluation site: canonical capability catalog shared with the private workbench, evidence-level assessments, hands-on evaluations and evidence-grounded questions.
